repl.title: interactive console
repl.hints: Tab to complete · 'help' for commands · '?' after a command for hints · 'exit' to leave

sync.optReload: run velocity reload afterwards if the proxy is up
sync.applyHint: restart the proxy or run with --reload to apply
sync.proxyDown: proxy not running; the config applies on next start

ports.badRange: could not read "{text}" as a range; use a shape like 32560-32599

list.desc: Cluster-wide port map (game, plugin, external) with the machine each one binds on
list.legend: {ok} bound now, {off} not bound (stopped or drift), {warn} machine not reachable, {dot} external (not probed)

pools.desc: The pool catalog: what consumes each pool, and each machine's range and usage
pools.noConsumers: nothing yet; a plugin port declaration names it with `pool`
pools.footer:
the pool id is the mapping: provisioning takes `game`, a plugin's port spec
names its pool; every machine serves every pool, only the numbers differ

poolSet.desc: Define/update a pool cluster-wide, or override its range on one machine
poolSet.optMachine: override the range on this machine only
poolSet.optRemove: drop the pool (or, with --machine, that machine's override)
poolSet.needsRange: a new pool needs a range, e.g. 32560-32599
poolSet.badProtocol: --protocol must be tcp, udp or both
poolSet.overrideNeedsRange: a machine override needs a range and/or --reserve
poolSet.nothingWritten: nothing written; fix the pool definition and try again
poolSet.updatedEverywhere: pool "{id}" {change} on every machine without an override

check.desc: Audit ports: per-machine duplicates, pool coverage, config drift, velocity.toml
check.optFix: rewrite plugin configs from the registry

cleanup.desc: Delete junk (cache, old versions, crash reports) + archive rotated logs centrally
cleanup.archived: archived {count} log files into {archives} monthly archive(s)

list.desc: List managed plugins, versions and targets
list.legend: {count} addons: {ok} auto-update on, {off} off, +Nv = per-instance variants/pins (see plugins info)

scan.desc: Scan pool + instances, identify jars on Modrinth, rebuild lockfile
scan.caseMismatches: filename case mismatches (these NEVER received updates from the old sync script):
scan.recognized: {count} instance file(s) are a pooled build under another name (register with: luna instance adopt-addons <instance>)
scan.unmanaged: {count} instance-only jars not in the pool; left where they are (adopt with: luna plugins adopt <instance> <jar>)

check.desc: Check providers for updates (per-instance version resolution)

update.desc: Download updates into the pool (then run plugins deploy)
update.deployHint: pool updated; push to instances with: {command}

deploy.desc: Sync pool jars to instances per target lists (fixes case mismatches)
deploy.portNote: (config appears after first boot; rerun deploy)
deploy.needRestart: running instances with updated jars (restart to apply): {names}

add.desc: Install a plugin or mod from a provider (slug, or search query)
add.optPool: pool the jar only; deploy it nowhere yet
add.optNeoforge: install the neoforge mod (searches mods, not plugins)
add.optProvider: where to install from: modrinth (default), curseforge or hangar
add.platformConflict: --velocity and --neoforge are different platforms; pick one
add.optFamily: ecosystem the build is for (paper, velocity, neoforge, fabric, forge)

apply.desc: Add instances to a plugin's targets and deploy
apply.optReplace: set the target list to exactly --to (e.g. collapse names into *paper)
apply.dropped: no longer targeted: {names}; their copies stay on disk, remove them with "{command}"

remove.desc: Remove a plugin from instances (--from), or everywhere + pool
remove.confirm: Remove {name} from ALL instances and the pool?
remove.restartNote: running instances keep the plugin loaded until restart

adopt.desc: Adopt an instance-only jar into the managed pool

upload.desc: Pool a jar from this machine (deploys to --to, or nowhere)
upload.badFamily: --family must be paper, velocity, universal or neoforge

info.desc: Show a plugin's versions, per-instance assignments and requirements

pin.desc: Pin instance(s) to a specific plugin version (downloads it as a variant)
pin.optOn: targets to pin (default: all of the plugin's targets)
pin.optForce: pin even if the version doesn't list the target's MC version

unpin.desc: Remove version pins (back to automatic per-instance resolution)

compat.desc: Server-version requirement check: can an instance (at a given MC version) run its plugins?
compat.argMc: defaults to the instance's current version
compat.noVersion: no MC version known for this instance; pass one explicitly
compat.noPlugins: no managed paper plugins target this instance
compat.heading: plugin compatibility for {name} on MC {mc}:
compat.needDifferent: {count} plugin(s) need a different version; run {command} after switching
compat.someUnknown: (some requirements unknown; run plugins check to backfill)

groupRestart.onNextRestart: instances using {name} pick the change up on their next restart

validate.desc: How a group selection lands on an instance (OK / no version / skipped)

fetch.desc: Download a build compatible with an MC version into the pool
fetch.optMc: MC version the build must support

config.desc: Show a plugin's config template, or apply all templates to an instance

override.desc: Force-add, disable or clear a plugin on one instance (wins over its groups)
override.optEnable: force-add the plugin, regardless of groups
override.optDisable: disable the plugin, even when a group provides it
override.optClear: drop the override; groups decide again
override.loadedNote: (a running server keeps it loaded until restart)

state.desc: Runtime state of every plugin on an instance, with log warn/error counts
state.incompleteSession: boot marker not found within the log-rotation window; load states past the window read as unknown
state.troubled: {count} plugin(s) reported errors; inspect with: luna logs {name}

standardize.desc: Migrate every entry to the <plugin>@<family> naming scheme (pool, lockfile, ports, instances)
standardize.confirm: Rename pool jars + lockfile keys + port allocations, redeploy everywhere and remove the old-name jars?
standardize.parityOk: parity verified: every instance runs the same plugin set as before

identify.desc: Map an existing plugin/mod to a provider project (so updates apply)
identify.optVersion: version id to record as installed
identify.optUnidentified: record the project but no version
identify.optAuto: auto-update: on or off (default on only for a proven match)
identify.optYes: accept an unproven match without asking
identify.unproven: nothing proved which version this is; re-run with --version <id>, --unidentified, or --yes

forget.desc: Drop a plugin's provider mapping (keeps the jar and its deployments)
forget.done: {name} is no longer mapped to a provider; updates will not be checked

packs.reloadHint: apply live with: luna packs reload
packs.optChannel: release channel: release, beta or alpha

list.empty: no resource packs; add one with: luna packs add <slug>
list.runtime: {count} pack(s) registered by a plugin at runtime: {names}; luna has no definition for them
list.shadowed: {key}: your {file} overrides the plugin that also registers it; release it with: {command}

add.desc: Install a resource pack from a provider (slug, or search query)
add.optProvider: where to install from: modrinth (default) or curseforge
add.startsDisabled: the pack starts disabled; enable it with: {command}

set.desc: Edit a pack's registration (priority, required, servers, enabled)
set.optChannel: update channel: release, beta or alpha

probe.likely: probably {version}; matched by {basis}, not a hash
probe.noMatch: no published version matches this file
probe.newest: newest release: {version}; what an unidentified mapping would pull

identify.desc: Map an existing resource pack to a provider project (so updates apply)
identify.noVersionNote: with no version recorded, the next check offers the newest compatible release

forget.desc: Drop a resource pack's provider mapping (keeps the zip and its rules)

takeover.desc: Take over a plugin-registered pack by writing its definition
takeover.detail: priority {priority}, {required}, servers {servers}; the plugin no longer decides these

releaseCmd.desc: Give a taken-over pack back to the plugin that registers it
releaseCmd.dynamicApplies: the plugin's own registration applies again: priority {priority}, servers {servers}

serve.desc: Serve a pack on one or more backends (stop serving with --off)
serve.optOff: stop serving the pack on those backends
serve.groupConflict: {instance} is granted by addon group(s) {groups}; the exclusion overrides the grant, but removing it from the group is cleaner

info.desc: One pack in full: contents, serve URL, reachability, holders and traffic
info.optRetest: re-measure the pack URL instead of using the stored answer
info.notInCatalog: not in the running catalog; reload the proxy

update.desc: Check resource packs for provider updates (apply with --apply)
update.optApply: download the updates instead of listing them
update.upToDate: every resource pack is up to date

remove.desc: Remove a resource pack (definition, zip and lock entry)
remove.optKeepFile: remove the registration but keep the zip

reload.desc: Ask the running proxy to re-read the packs directory (lunapack reload)
reload.proxyDown: the proxy is not running; packs load on its next boot

list.desc: List pooled data packs and where they deploy
list.empty: no data packs; add one with: luna datapacks add <slug> --to <instance>

add.desc: Install a data pack from a provider (slug, or search query)
add.optProvider: where to install from: modrinth (default), curseforge or smithed
add.needsTo: --to is required (which instances' worlds get the pack)

deploy.desc: Sync pooled data packs into target instances' worlds
deploy.restartNote: running servers load the change on their next restart (or /minecraft:reload)

update.desc: Check data packs for provider updates (apply with --apply)
update.upToDate: every data pack is up to date

adopt.desc: Adopt a hand-dropped zip from an instance's world into the pool

remove.desc: Remove a data pack from worlds (and the pool when nothing targets it)

identify.desc: Map an existing data pack to a provider project (so updates apply)

forget.desc: Drop a data pack's provider mapping (keeps the zip and its targets)

groups.desc: List addon groups and the instances using them

group.desc: Show, create or edit an addon group (then apply it + optional restart)
group.optPlugins: set membership to this comma-separated plugin list
group.optRespacks: set the resource pack members, comma-separated
group.optDatapacks: set the data pack members, comma-separated
group.optRestart: after a change: "now", "none" (default), or a time
group.unknown: unknown group: {name}; pass --plugins to create it
group.notPooledPlugin: "{name}" is not a pooled plugin; it validates as missing until installed
group.notRegisteredRespack: "{name}" is not a registered resource pack; install or upload it first
group.notPooledDatapack: "{name}" is not a pooled data pack; install or upload it first
group.saved: group {name} saved: {plugins} plugin(s), {respacks} resource pack(s), {datapacks} data pack(s)
group.removedStay: removed plugins stay deployed; clean them with {command}

apply.desc: Re-apply every group's packs: rewrite pack rules and deploy data packs
apply.proxyDown: (proxy down; applies on its next boot)

status.desc: Show status of all instances (or one)

stop.forced: {name}: graceful stop timed out, sent SIGTERM

console.desc: Attach to an instance console (detach: Ctrl+A then D)

send.desc: Send a console command to a running instance

create.desc: Create a new paper instance and register it with the proxy
create.optSet: server settings, e.g. difficulty=hard,max-players=100 (see instance settings)
create.optRuntime: managed java runtime id (installed on first start)
create.optDaemon: follower daemon that will own the instance
create.velocityUpdated: velocity.toml updated (reload the proxy to apply)
create.optLoaderVersion: pin the loader build instead of taking the newest
create.softwareNoProvider: luna cannot download {software}; it can only be adopted
create.softwareHasNoJava: {software} is not a JVM program; drop --runtime and --java-args
create.noVersions: {software} has no published versions to install

adopt.desc: Register a server directory that already exists as a managed instance
adopt.optDaemon: daemon whose disk holds the directory
adopt.optDir: directory name under that daemon's root (default: the name)
adopt.optMemory: override the detected heap size, e.g. 8G
adopt.optJava: pin a java binary; modpacks often need an older JDK
adopt.optDryRun: show what was detected, registering nothing
adopt.velocityUpdated: velocity.toml updated; reload the proxy to apply
adopt.unmanaged: {count} addon(s) left unmanaged; the server keeps its own

adoptAddons.desc: Re-check an instance's own plugins/mods/data packs against the pool

setVersion.desc: Switch an instance to a different MC version (downloads latest build)
setVersion.abortIncompatible: aborted: {count} plugin(s) incompatible with {mc}; fix with plugins update/pin after switching, or pass --force
setVersion.unknownReqs: {count} plugin(s) have unknown MC requirements (luna/manual jars; verify manually)
setVersion.updateHint: re-resolve plugin versions for the new MC: {command}
setVersion.optLoaderVersion: pin the loader build instead of taking the newest

settings.desc: Show or change an instance's server settings (difficulty, max-players, pvp, …)
settings.unknownKey: "{key}" is not a known server setting; run "luna instance settings {name}" for the list

config.notABoolean: {value} is not a yes/no value (true, false, on, off)
config.desc: Get/set instance settings (memory, profile, port, javaArgs, javaAgents, or any server.properties key)
config.optClear: unpin an optional field (java, runtime, javaArgs, javaAgents)
config.notClearable: {key} cannot be cleared; it always has a value

remove.desc: Deregister an instance (--purge also deletes its directory)
remove.optPurge: DELETE the instance directory from disk

access.desc: Show an instance's whitelist, operators and bans

accessAdd.desc: Add a player (or IP) to one of an instance's access lists

accessRemove.desc: Remove a player (or IP) from one of an instance's access lists

whitelist.desc: Turn an instance's whitelist on or off

registered.desc: The player directory: everyone the network has ever recorded

player.desc: One player's profile: identity, playtime, permissions, moderation

skin.desc: Change or reset a player's skin through SkinsRestorer
skin.optUrl: generate from a public image URL (via MineSkin)
skin.resetDone: {player}'s stored skin dropped; their own skin applies again

auth.desc: A player's authentication state, as luna-auth holds it

vault.desc: A player's balance and recent transactions, as LunaVault holds them

password.desc: Reset a player's password, or issue a temporary one
password.optReset: clear the password; the player must /register again
password.optTemporary: issue a temporary password, generated unless --password is given
password.optMinutes: how long a temporary password lasts (default 1440)
password.optUnlock: clear a lockout from failed attempts
password.expiresNote: expires {date}; only its hash is stored

permsGroups.desc: LuckPerms groups across the network, heaviest weight first

permsGroup.desc: One LuckPerms group: meta, nodes and members

permsUser.desc: One player's LuckPerms data: groups and direct nodes

setup.desc: Install and configure this machine's daemon as a system service (run with sudo)
setup.optName: daemon name, unique across the cluster
setup.optUser: account the daemon and its servers run as
setup.optHost: follower: LAN address the primary routes to
setup.optNoStart: write everything but leave the service stopped
setup.optDryRun: print every change without making one
setup.optYes: take the defaults instead of prompting
setup.noexec: {bin} will not execute ({error}); if {root} is mounted noexec the daemon cannot run its own binary from there
setup.wouldSeed: would seed {path} with an empty cluster
setup.noAnswer: the daemon did not answer in time
setup.badConfig: {path} is not valid JSON; starting from defaults
setup.primaryHint: owns the registry, plugins and schedules; serves the console
setup.followerHint: runs the instances the primary assigns to it
setup.askHost: LAN address the primary routes to (blank = auto)
setup.askToken: Cluster token (from `luna daemon token` on the primary)
setup.needsToken: a follower needs the cluster token; run `luna daemon token` on the primary
setup.notCompiled: run this from the compiled binary: `bun run build`, then `sudo ./dist/luna setup`
setup.needsRoot: luna setup writes to /usr/local/bin, /etc and systemd; it needs root
setup.dryRunNote: dry run: nothing below is written
setup.wouldCreateUser: would create system user {name} homed at {root}
setup.noSystemd: this machine is not running systemd; the unit was written but not enabled
setup.tokenNote: every follower needs that same token; keep it out of shell history
setup.followerListed: the primary should now list it: {command}
setup.pathNote: open a new shell for {name} to be on your PATH, or {command}
setup.sudoNote: sudo ignores your PATH; re-run this installer as {command}

run.desc: Run the luna daemon in the foreground (primary or follower, per its config)

status.desc: Show the daemon this host's clients are talking to
status.noDaemon: no daemon is running on this host
status.startHint: start one with {run} or install the service: {install}

list.desc: List every daemon in the cluster with live state

show.desc: Health, checks and instance memory of one daemon
show.quarantineFix: run `luna daemon upgrade {name}` to bring it back into the cluster

upgrade.desc: Upgrade a daemon, from this primary's binary or the GitHub release
upgrade.optCheck: report what each channel offers without upgrading
upgrade.optForce: upgrade even when the build matches or jobs are running
upgrade.noSource: no upgrade source could be reached
upgrade.exitNote: it exits now; the service manager restarts it on the new build

remove.stillConnected: daemon "{name}" is currently connected; stop it first
remove.ownsInstances: daemon "{name}" still owns {names}; reassign or delete those instances first

token.optNew: generate a fresh token instead of showing the current one
token.setHint: set as {key} in every daemon's config (primary and followers)
token.adoptNote: nothing adopts this until you write it; followers stay on the old token meanwhile
token.notConfigured: no token configured in {file}; generate one with "luna daemon token --new"
token.noConfig: no daemon config on this machine; generate a token with "luna daemon token --new"
token.fromFile: from {file}; every follower needs this same value

service.desc: Write a systemd unit so the daemon runs 24/7
service.optUser: install as a user service (no root needed)
service.optConfig: daemon config file the unit should point at
service.manualHint: write it yourself with the following content:

list.desc: Managed config files: templates luna renders into instances on every start
list.empty: no managed config files; create one from the console's file browser
list.driftWarning: {count} file(s) changed outside luna; re-adopt with: luna configs readopt <instance> <file>

ls.desc: List one level of an instance's directory

show.desc: Print a config file (the template, when it is managed)
show.optRendered: print what is on disk rather than the template
show.missing: undefined: {names}; rendering is refused until they exist
show.driftNote: the file on disk was changed outside luna; the next start overwrites it

manage.desc: Take a config file under management, adopting its current text as the template
manage.note: luna renders it from the template on every start; edit it in the console

unmanage.desc: Stop managing a config file, leaving it on disk as it is
unmanage.done: {file} released; the last render stays on disk

placeholder.desc: Replace a literal value in a config file with an ${ENV_VAR}
placeholder.optAll: replace every occurrence, not just the first
placeholder.optInstanceScope: define the variable for this instance only
placeholder.optMachine: define the variable for one machine only
placeholder.optForce: accept a value or file change that would otherwise be refused
placeholder.scopeConflict: --machine and --instance-scope are different scopes; pass one
placeholder.rewritten: the rendered file differs from what was there; it was rewritten (forced)
placeholder.unchanged: the file on disk is unchanged; the value simply lives in the environment now

render.desc: Render an instance's managed config files from their templates

readopt.desc: Pull a drifted file's current text back into its template, keeping placeholders
readopt.nowLiteral: no placeholder values matched the new text; the template is now literal

discardDrift.desc: Delete the .luna-drift copy kept beside a file

list.desc: Java runtimes installed across the fleet

available.desc: Java runtimes the vendors publish for a machine
available.optMachine: the machine whose platform decides the builds
available.optRefresh: refetch instead of using the cached catalog
available.forPlatform: builds for {machine}'s platform; install with luna runtime install <id>

install.desc: Download and install a java runtime on a machine
install.optMachine: machine to install it on (default: the primary)
install.optForce: reinstall even when it is already there

remove.desc: Delete a java runtime from a machine
remove.optMachine: machine to remove it from (default: the primary)
remove.optForce: remove even while something still asks for it
remove.forcedNote: a server already running on it keeps running until it restarts

show.desc: Where one java runtime is installed, and what uses it
show.title: runtime {id}

suggest.desc: The java feature release a Minecraft version needs

list.desc: Java profiles: the JVM flag sets instances launch with

add.optRuntime: managed runtime id the profile launches on

edit.optRuntime: managed runtime id the profile launches on
edit.optFlags: replace the JVM flags, space separated
edit.optJarArgs: replace the arguments appended after the jar
edit.nothing: nothing to change; pass at least one field
edit.restartNote: instances pick the change up on their next start

rename.desc: Rename a java profile, moving every instance using it

env.scopeConflict: --instance and --machine are different scopes; pass one

list.desc: List environment variables (injected at startup, and read by templates as ${NAME})
list.optInstance: resolve for this instance, showing what wins
list.optReveal: show secret values instead of masking them
list.resolvedFor: resolved for {name}: builtin < global < machine < instance
list.empty: no variables defined; set one with: luna env set NAME value
list.builtinsHint: builtins are per-instance; see them with {command}

set.desc: Set a variable, globally or as a machine/instance override
set.optMachine: override for every instance on this machine
set.optSecret: mask the value in every UI
set.pickupNote: (instances pick it up on their next start)

unset.desc: Remove a variable, or one machine's/instance's override
unset.restartNote: instances keep the old value until they restart

inject.desc: Rewrite an instance's .luna-env from the store (takes effect on its next start)
inject.applyNote: the JVM reads it at startup; restart the instance to apply

apply.desc: Re-apply every config template and managed config file to an instance
apply.templatesInPlace: {name}: every templated value already in place ({count} checked)
apply.filesUpToDate: {name}: {count} managed config file(s) already up to date

luna.noArtifacts: no built artifacts found; run luna luna build first
luna.registered: registered {name} in the lockfile; assign targets with {command}
luna.poolMatches: pool already matches the built jars

status.desc: Compare built luna jars against the pool and every instance
status.hashing: hashing built, pooled and deployed jars...
status.stray: stray artifact in output/: {file} (no gradle module produces it)

build.desc: Build the luna-plugins workspace (all modules, or the ones named)
build.optSync: also copy the built jars into the pool
build.dirty: source tree has uncommitted changes; jars stamped {version}

sync.desc: Copy already-built luna jars into the pool and update the lockfile

deploy.desc: Build luna plugins, pool them, and push to their target instances
deploy.optNoBuild: deploy what is already in output/ without rebuilding
deploy.optRestart: restart the instances that received a new jar
deploy.nothing: nothing to deploy; instances already run these jars

status.desc: Network telemetry from LunaCore on the proxy (TPS, CPU, RAM, players)
status.summary: network {health}: {online}/{total} backends up, {players} players, avg tps {tps}, avg cpu {cpu}%, ram {ramUsed} / {ramMax}

players.desc: Players connected to the network, with session times

history.desc: Recent join, leave and server-switch activity
history.empty: no activity recorded since the proxy started

cmd.desc: Run a command on the proxy console and print its reply
cmd.noSuchCommand: no such command on the proxy
cmd.notRecognised: the proxy did not recognise that command

say.desc: Broadcast a MiniMessage-formatted message to players

kick.desc: Disconnect a player from the network

move.desc: Move a player to another backend

list.desc: List schedules (the runner lives in the web console server)
list.empty: no schedules; create one with: luna schedule create

create.desc: Schedule an instance start/stop/restart (once, cron, or fixed rate)
create.nextRun: next run {time}; fires while the daemon runs

remove.desc: Delete a schedule (its history stays in the event log)

enable.completed: {name} has already completed; nothing left to fire

run.desc: Fire a schedule's action right now (does not consume a scheduled run)

selector.diffHeading: differences between the file and what luna would generate:

status.desc: Show the server selector: placement, validation and drift from servers.yml
status.notConfigured: not configured; run luna selector migrate
status.noFile: no servers.yml yet; apply will create it
status.drift: servers.yml differs from cluster.json ({count} path(s)); apply to bring it in line
status.proxyUnreachable: the proxy's HTTP API did not answer; apply can write the file but not reload it

check.desc: Validate the selector the way the proxy would before a reload
check.wouldRefuse: {count} error(s); the proxy would refuse to reload

preview.desc: Print the servers.yml luna would generate, without writing it

migrate.desc: Import the existing servers.yml into cluster.json (one-time)
migrate.optDryRun: report what would be imported, saving nothing
migrate.optForce: save even when the round-trip check finds differences
migrate.confirm: Import servers.yml into cluster.json? This rewrites the selector metadata of every matching instance.
migrate.roundTripOk: round-trip check passed; regenerating reproduces the current configuration
migrate.nothingSaved: nothing saved; re-run with --force to import anyway

apply.desc: Generate servers.yml from cluster.json and reload the proxy
apply.confirm: Write servers.yml ({count} server(s)) and reload the live proxy?
apply.reloaded: proxy reloaded; backends pick the new layout up on their next heartbeat
apply.notReloaded: the proxy did not reload; run /lunacoreproxy reload there, or restart it

web.desc: Start the web console (SvelteKit app in control/web)
web.optDev: run the vite dev server instead of the production build
web.followerHost: this host runs the "{name}" follower daemon; the web console only runs on the primary
web.buildMissing: production build missing; run: cd {dir} && bun run build
web.optBehindProxy: trust X-Forwarded-* from a reverse proxy in front of the console
web.optProxyDepth: how many of our own proxies to count back through (default 1)
web.behindProxy: reverse-proxy mode: reading the client address from X-Forwarded-For, depth {depth}

version.desc: Build identity of this binary (and the daemon, when one answers)

accounts.passwordNeeded: pass --password when stdin is not a terminal
accounts.passwordMismatch: the two passwords do not match

list.desc: console accounts: who may sign in to the web console
list.none: no console accounts exist yet, so the console is in first-run mode

show.desc: one console account: its fields, identities and lockout state
show.noIdentities: this account has no identity, so nothing can sign in as it

add.optPassword: the console password, instead of being prompted for it
add.optDisplay: display name shown in the console
add.optEmail: email address, for the operator's own records
add.optMustChange: ask for a new password on the first sign-in
add.optDisabled: create it disabled, to be enabled later
add.optNoPassword: create it without a console password
add.noPasswordNote: {name} has no password yet; set one with luna account password {name}

password.optPassword: the new password, instead of being prompted for it
password.optReset: an administrator's reset; the owner is asked for a new one on next sign-in
password.mustChangeNote: the owner will be asked to choose a new password on their next sign-in

enable.desc: enable a console account and clear any lockout

disable.desc: disable a console account and close its sessions

unlock.desc: clear a console account's failed-attempt lockout

remove.desc: delete a console account and every session it holds
remove.confirm: Delete {name} and close its {sessions} open session(s)?

key.desc: mint an access key for a console account
key.onceOnly: this is the only time the secret is shown; store it now

link.desc: link a Minecraft profile to a console account

unlink.desc: remove one identity from a console account

revoke.desc: close a console session, or every session an account holds
revoke.optAccount: close every session this account holds
revoke.needTarget: name a session id, or pass --account

audit.desc: the console's account audit trail, newest first
audit.optAccount: only entries naming this account, as subject or actor

logs.desc: the console journal for this machine: daemon, web and CLI activity
logs.optSearch: only entries whose message, detail or actor contains this text
logs.none: the journal has nothing matching that
